items.quote: his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah
items.claim: Jacob's sons transported and buried his body in the cave of Machpelah in Canaan

items.quote: which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite
items.claim: Abraham purchased the field of Machpelah from Ephron the Hittite specifically to serve as a burial place
